title: Information Visualization
workloadNotes: Group final project building a multi-step interactive data visualization website (student example: a 6-step earthquake data story built with D3.js). Course description (from official listing, not this repo) notes a 14-week structure with weekly readings, lecture, and lab/design-jam sessions, prerequisite EECS 493 or graduate standing.
prerequisitesText: EECS 493 or graduate standing (per official course listing)
